[workspace] members = ["crates/xberg", "crates/ffi", "packages/python", "packages/typescript"] resolver = "2"

[workspace.package] version = "4.2.10" authors = ["Xberg Contributors"] edition = "2024" license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[workspace.dependencies] tokio = { version = "1.35", features = ["full"] } serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] } serde_json = "1.0" anyhow = "1.0" thiserror = "1.0" log = "0.4" tracing = "0.1" tracing-subscriber = "0.3" html5ever = "0.26" ammonia = "4.1" regex = "1.10" encoding_rs = "0.8" lazy_static = "1.4"

[package] name = "xberg" version.workspace = true authors.workspace = true edition.workspace = true license.workspace = true description = "High-performance document extraction and intelligence library" documentation = "https://docs.rs/xberg" homepage = "https://xberg.io" repository = "https://github.com/xberg/xberg" readme = "README.md"

[profile.release] opt-level = 3 lto = true codegen-units = 1 strip = true

[profile.dev] opt-level = 0 debug = true

[dependencies] tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread"] } serde = { workspace = true } serde_json = { workspace = true } anyhow = { workspace = true } thiserror = { workspace = true } log = { workspace = true } tracing = { workspace = true } tracing-subscriber = { workspace = true } html5ever = { workspace = true } ammonia = { workspace = true } regex = { workspace = true } encoding_rs = { workspace = true } lazy_static = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies] criterion = { version = "0.5", features = ["html_reports"] } proptest = "1.4"

[features] default = ["html5ever", "unicode"] full = ["html5ever", "unicode", "pdf-extract"] html5ever = [] unicode = [] pdf-extract = ["dep:pdfium-render"] experimental = []

[[bench]] name = "extraction" harness = false

[[example]] name = "basic_extraction" path = "examples/basic_extraction.rs"

[lib] name = "xberg" path = "src/lib.rs" crate-type = ["rlib"]

content.plain:
[workspace]
members = ["crates/xberg", "crates/ffi", "packages/python", "packages/typescript"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.package]
version = "4.2.10"
authors = ["Xberg Contributors"]
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1.35", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
anyhow = "1.0"
thiserror = "1.0"
log = "0.4"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = "0.3"
html5ever = "0.26"
ammonia = "4.1"
regex = "1.10"
encoding_rs = "0.8"
lazy_static = "1.4"

[package]
name = "xberg"
version.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
description = "High-performance document extraction and intelligence library"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/xberg"
homepage = "https://xberg.io"
repository = "https://github.com/xberg/xberg"
readme = "README.md"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
strip = true

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 0
debug = true

[dependencies]
tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread"] }
serde = { workspace = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true }
anyhow = { workspace = true }
thiserror = { workspace = true }
log = { workspace = true }
tracing = { workspace = true }
tracing-subscriber = { workspace = true }
html5ever = { workspace = true }
ammonia = { workspace = true }
regex = { workspace = true }
encoding_rs = { workspace = true }
lazy_static = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies]
criterion = { version = "0.5", features = ["html_reports"] }
proptest = "1.4"

[features]
default = ["html5ever", "unicode"]
full = ["html5ever", "unicode", "pdf-extract"]
html5ever = []
unicode = []
pdf-extract = ["dep:pdfium-render"]
experimental = []

[[bench]]
name = "extraction"
harness = false

[[example]]
name = "basic_extraction"
path = "examples/basic_extraction.rs"

[lib]
name = "xberg"
path = "src/lib.rs"
crate-type = ["rlib"]
